E)AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF
NETHERLANDS STIPULATING THAT ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR
OPERATED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSONS FROM THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION
OR BY OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY
THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT
OR OVERFLY THE NETHERLANDS, AS STATED IN NETHERLANDS AIP SUP 06/23,
THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY INFORM
THAT ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL
PERSONS OF THE NETHERLANDS OR BY OPERATORS HOLDING AOC ISSUED BY
THE DUTCH AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED FROM ENTERING, EXITING OR
OVERFLYING THE AIRSPACE OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION, EXCEPT FOR
AIRCRAFT IN EMERGENCY, HUMANITARIAN AND AMBULANCE FLIGHTS AS WELL
AS IN CASES WHEN A SPECIAL PERMISSION FOR FLIGHT OPERATIONS IS
GRANTED BY THE FEDERAL AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY OR THE MINISTRY OF
FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION, AS APPROPRIATE.
